data_caveat_body: This app is not an official service provided by Nakatsu City — it is an unofficial prototype (PoC) created independently by an individual. Some shelter locations are approximate. Always follow official disaster information and instructions from Nakatsu City in an actual emergency. Please also prepare a paper map and spare battery power in case of network or power outages.
